note: Helena-Lewis and Clark NF (Rocky Mountain Ranger District) campground at Marias Pass on US-2, 11 mi west of East Glacier, beside Memorial Square (Theodore Roosevelt memorial obelisk). A 3-mile spur trail reaches the Continental Divide Trail and the Bob Marshall Wilderness. --Claude
summary: Found the campground's own page on the Helena-Lewis and Clark NF (not Flathead): confirmed 17 sites and vault toilets; added $20 (2026), season late spring to early fall, water off for the freezing period from Oct 13, 2026. Cleared the derived 'reservable on recreation.gov' (no recreation.gov listing; the FS page offers no reservations). Not stated: max rig length (35 ft derived left), the 14-day stay limit (derived left), discounts. Note corrected (wrong forest, 'check recreation.gov') and trimmed of restated values.
flags: Wrong website: the entry links the generic Flathead NF camping page, but the campground belongs to the Helena-Lewis and Clark NF (Rocky Mountain Ranger District); its own page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/summit-campground.
Missing phone: the Forest Service page gives only the Helena-Lewis and Clark Supervisor's Office, 406-449-5201 (the Rocky Mountain Ranger District office is not listed on the page).

Booking: the derived reservable/recreation.gov (from note prose) is contradicted (no recreation.gov facility, no reservation link on the FS page) and was cleared; the campground is very likely first-come, but the page does not say so.
max_rig_ft 35 (derived from note prose, originally a Visit Montana listing) is not stated on the Forest Service page.
